question: The World bank comprises of __________. (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (03/12/2024) Shift 1)
options: WTO
GATT
IMF
IBRD
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is IBRD

Explanation:
The World Bank was established in 1944 under the Bretton Woods Conference. It primarily consists of IBRD (International Bank for Reconstruction and Development) and IDA (International Development Association). IBRD provides loans to middle-income countries, while IDA offers concessional loans to the poorest nations. The World Bank Group includes five institutions: IBRD, IDA, IFC (International Finance Corporation), MIGA (Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency), and ICSID (International Centre for Settlement of Investment Disputes). WTO and GATT are trade-related organizations, while IMF is a separate Bretton Woods institution.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:

☛ IBRD established → 1944, Bretton Woods Conference
☛ Total institutions in World Bank Group → 5
☛ Provides concessional loans to poor countries → IDA
☛ Finances the private sector → IFC
question_hi: विश्व बैंक में __________ शामिल हैं। (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (03/12/2024) Shift 1)

GATT
IMF
IBRD
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है IBRD

Explanation:
विश्व बैंक का गठन 1944 में ब्रेटन वुड्स सम्मेलन के तहत किया गया था। यह मुख्य रूप से IBRD (इंटरनेशनल बैंक फॉर रिकंस्ट्रक्शन एंड डेवलपमेंट) और IDA (इंटरनेशनल डेवलपमेंट एसोसिएशन) से मिलकर बना है। IBRD मध्यम आय वाले देशों को ऋण प्रदान करता है, जबकि IDA गरीब देशों को रियायती ऋण देता है। विश्व बैंक समूह में कुल पांच संस्थान शामिल हैं: IBRD, IDA, IFC (इंटरनेशनल फाइनेंस कॉरपोरेशन), MIGA (मल्टीलेटरल इन्वेस्टमेंट गारंटी एजेंसी), और ICSID (इंटरनेशनल सेंटर फॉर सेटलमेंट ऑफ इन्वेस्टमेंट डिस्प्यूट्स)। WTO और GATT विश्व व्यापार से संबंधित संगठन हैं, जबकि IMF एक अलग ब्रेटन वुड्स संस्था है।

question: ‘Kathasaritasagara’ is a collection of stories composed in __________. (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (03/12/2024) Shift 1)

question: When was 'Victoria Memorial' built in India? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (03/12/2024) Shift 1)
options: 1857
1900
1806
1906
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1906

Explanation:
The Victoria Memorial in Kolkata, India, was built starting in 1906. It was constructed in memory of Queen Victoria, who died in 1901. The design was prepared by William Emerson and is a fine example of Indo-Saracenic architecture. Construction began in 1906 and was completed in 1921. It was inaugurated in 1921 by the Prince of Wales (later King Edward VIII). Today, it serves as a museum and tourist attraction. The other options are incorrect: 1857 is the year of the Indian Rebellion, 1900 is not the year of Queen Victoria's death (she died in 1901), and 1806 is unrelated to the Victoria Memorial.

question: In which of the following years was GATT established? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (03/12/2024) Shift 2)
options: 1947
1948
1946
1949
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1948

Explanation:
The General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) was signed in 1947 but came into effect on 1 January 1948. It was established after World War II to liberalize global trade and reduce tariffs. The headquarters of GATT was in Geneva, Switzerland. It was replaced by the World Trade Organization (WTO) in 1995. GATT played a crucial role in promoting non-discrimination and transparency in international trade. Several rounds of negotiations were held under GATT, with the Uruguay Round being the most significant as it led to the creation of the WTO. The agreement aimed to boost economic recovery and cooperation among nations.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:

☛ Where is the headquarters of GATT located? → Geneva, Switzerland
☛ Which organization replaced GATT? → World Trade Organization (WTO)
☛ Which round of GATT led to the formation of WTO? → Uruguay Round
☛ What are the principles of GATT? → Non-discrimination and transparency

options_hi: 1947

1946

solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है 1948

Explanation:
GATT (General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade) एक अंतरराष्ट्रीय व्यापार समझौता था जिसे 1947 में हस्ताक्षरित किया गया था लेकिन 1 जनवरी 1948 को लागू हुआ। इसे द्वितीय विश्व युद्ध के बाद वैश्विक व्यापार को उदार बनाने और टैरिफ कम करने के उद्देश्य से बनाया गया था। GATT का मुख्यालय जिनेवा, स्विट्जरलैंड में स्थित है। यह 1995 में विश्व व्यापार संगठन (WTO) में परिवर्तित हो गया। GATT के तहत कई दौर की वार्ताएं हुईं, जिनमें उरुग्वे राउंड सबसे महत्वपूर्ण रहा जिसके कारण WTO का गठन हुआ। GATT ने अंतरराष्ट्रीय व्यापार में गैर-भेदभाव और पारदर्शिता के सिद्धांतों को बढ़ावा दिया।

question: To which Gharana did the renowned singer Girija Devi, known for her 'Thumri' renditions, belong? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (03/12/2024) Shift 2)

Explanation:

The Benaras Gharana is a major school of Hindustani classical music, known for its renditions of Thumri, Bhajan, and Kajri. Girija Devi carried forward the traditions of this gharana and gave international recognition to Thumri singing. She was honored with prestigious awards like Padma Shri (1972) and Padma Bhushan (1989). The Benaras Gharana emphasizes bandish and bol-banao (embellishment of lyrics), and Girija Devi enriched this style with her captivating performances.

question: Who among the following is revered as 'Karnataka Sangita Pitamaha'? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (09/12/2024) Shift 1)
options: Tyagaraja Dasa

Annamacharya Dasa

Explanation:
Purandara Dasa is revered as the 'Karnataka Sangita Pitamaha' (Grandfather of Carnatic Music) because he systematized the teaching of Carnatic music. He played a key role in the Bhakti movement and made music accessible to the common people. His contributions earned him this title. Other great composers like Tyagaraja, Muthuswami Dikshitar, and Annamacharya are not given this specific title.

question: Who among the following was a classical Hindustani singer? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (09/12/2024) Shift 2)
options: V Sheshanna
MS Subbulakshmi
Begum Akhtar
TK Iyengar
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Begum Akhtar

Explanation:
Begum Akhtar (1914-1974) was a renowned classical Hindustani singer, known as the 'Mallika-e-Ghazal' (Queen of Ghazals). She specialized in ghazal, dadra, and thumri styles. In contrast, MS Subbulakshmi and V Sheshanna were associated with Carnatic classical music, while TK Iyengar was a violinist in the Carnatic tradition. Begum Akhtar was awarded the Padma Shri in 1968 and the Padma Bhushan posthumously in 1975. She was one of the few female Hindustani classical singers to popularize the ghazal style. Her deep, emotive voice and expressive style made her an enduring icon in Indian classical music.

question: The stone used for the construction of the Basilica of Bom Jesus in Goa was brought from which of the following places? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (09/12/2024) Shift 2)

question: The efficient market hypothesis (EMH) is foundational to the Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM). To test the validity of the EMH, one can examine whether historical data contradicts CAPM. If historical data were to contradict CAPM, which of the following would this imply about the efficient market hypothesis? (RPF SI CBT-I 2024 (09/12/2024) Shift 3)
options: It would imply that CAPM is infallible.
It would imply that the historical data is irrelevant to market efficiency
It would imply that the market is inefficient.
It would imply that the market is always efficient.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is It would imply that the market is inefficient.

Explanation:
The Efficient Market Hypothesis (EMH) states that asset prices fully reflect all available information. CAPM is built on EMH and assumes markets are efficient, so returns are solely determined by systematic risk (beta). If historical data contradicts CAPM, it indicates anomalies such as excess returns not explained by risk. This violates weak or semi-strong forms of EMH, as historical data can be used to achieve abnormal returns. Therefore, a contradiction of CAPM implies market inefficiency.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ What is EMH based on? → Asset prices fully reflecting all available information.
☛ What is the core principle of CAPM? → Returns depend only on systematic risk (beta).
☛ What are the three forms of EMH? → Weak, semi-strong, and strong.
☛ What does CAPM contradiction indicate? → Market anomalies and possible inefficiency.
☛ What does market inefficiency mean? → Prices do not fully reflect all information, allowing abnormal profits.

यह निहित करेगा कि बाजार हमेशा कुशल होता है।
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है यह निहित करेगा कि बाजार अकुशल है।

Explanation:
कुशल बाजार परिकल्पना (EMH) के अनुसार, परिसंपत्ति की कीमतें सभी उपलब्ध सूचनाओं को पूरी तरह से दर्शाती हैं। CAPM, EMH पर आधारित है और यह मानता है कि बाजार कुशल है, जिससे प्रतिफल केवल व्यवस्थित जोखिम (बीटा) पर निर्भर करता है। यदि ऐतिहासिक डेटा CAPM का खंडन करता है, तो इसका अर्थ है कि बाजार में विसंगतियां हैं, जैसे कि अतिरिक्त प्रतिफल जो जोखिम से स्पष्ट नहीं होते। यह EMH की कमजोर या अर्ध-सशक्त रूपों का उल्लंघन दर्शाता है, क्योंकि ऐतिहासिक डेटा का उपयोग करके असामान्य प्रतिफल प्राप्त किया जा सकता है। अतः, CAPM का खंडन बाजार की अकुशलता का संकेत देता है।
